corpus.name: L3Cube-HingCorpus (Roman script), pre-training corpus of l3cube-pune/hing-roberta (Nayak & Joshi 2022)
corpus.source_used: https://huggingface.co/datasets/hinglish-orthobench/HingCorpus (third-party re-upload; NOT verified identical to the original release)
corpus.note: Line count 52,933,356 matches the 52.93M sentences reported in the paper.

method: Exact match after normalisation (NFKC, lower-case, URLs/@mentions/'#' removed, punctuation->space, whitespace collapsed); only texts with >= 5 words checked. Near-duplicates NOT checked.
